context: Request: how often completed real-estate matters include an environmental indemnity in the executed documents, and which ones. Rubric: 1017-00009, 1026-00004, 1031-00004, 1036-00004, 1043-00003 as qualifying; frequency 5 of 9 (~56%); precision criterion on the qualifying set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Greps inside three listing-top matters plus one store-wide grep with a single-extension glob (labelled by the store-wide search); all return nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements and a memo of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request words; times out after about 186K chars from low-numbered matters.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists all matter folder names.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for property, lease and purchase words (first 200 hits), then a script listing such files per matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of a purchase agreement and five environmental-indemnity documents from six candidate matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of eleven candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of indemnities and purchase agreements from five candidate matters.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of one purchase agreement.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet-extraction script over three named purchase agreements for indemnity terms.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 5 of 9 with a core sample and qualifying list that include financing matters with standalone indemnities, plus a broader-scope sensitivity count.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Found and read the qualifying matters, but its qualifying list and sample counted property financings and other matters outside the request's scope.

first_error.why: It asserted several financing and land matters with standalone indemnity agreements as qualifying completed real-estate deals and built its sample from them, which the request's scope does not support.

runs.failure_point: The scan listed a qualifying matter, but the set of matters it chose to examine left it out; the answer also counted financing matters in its denominator and qualifying list.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its 413-file scan listed a qualifying purchase-agreement matter, but it opened only matters with standalone indemnity agreements and left that matter out of the set it examined and counted.

other_errors.why: It treated financing and other non-real-estate matters as completed real-estate matters in its sample and qualifying discussion.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Read the qualifying matters but counted any executed deal with environmental indemnity language, including asset purchases and corporate financings, as a completed real-estate matter.

first_error.why: It treated asset purchases and corporate financings with mortgages as completed real-estate matters and counted indemnity language in any executed document, asserting many matters outside the request.

divergence: All three runs reached and read the qualifying matters and passed most per-matter criteria; none passed precision. T0 and T2 failed at the write stage by counting matters outside the request's scope (financings with standalone indemnities in T0; asset purchases and corporate financings in T2), which also skewed T2's frequency (over-inclusion). T1 differs earlier: its scan listed a qualifying purchase-agreement matter, but it examined only matters with standalone indemnity agreements and left that one out (surfaced, never opened), then also over-included financing matters at the write stage.
